name: Knife Rat
summary: Knife Rat; Your melee attacks with light weapons score a critical hit on 19- 20.  Knife Rat; Your light melee attacks deal +1 damage.  Knife Rat; When you score a critical hit with a light melee weapon, the target cannot take reactions until its next turn.
